summary: Read the whole application timeline before spending effort on a locally slow kernel.
outcomes: Identify CPU gaps, serialization, copies and GPU idle periods.
Connect a source operation to its device work using annotations.
sequence: Profile a pipeline with an intentional CPU bottleneck.
Map host threads, API calls, streams and kernels.
Add useful ranges without drowning the trace.
Find the application critical path and hidden synchronization.
Change one cause and compare a fresh trace.

visual.question: What is the GPU waiting for at this point?
visual.interaction: Select an idle interval and follow its dependency back to the host or data source.

practice.task: Repair a pipeline containing unnecessary synchronization and input starvation.
practice.success: A before/after trace supports the diagnosis and end-to-end improvement.
